The template is `MERGE (incident:IncidentRoutingEvidence {uid: row.incident_uid}) ... MERGE (routing:IncidentRoutingEvidence {uid: row.uid}) ... MERGE (incident)-[rel:%s]->(routing)`, and the %s is filled per closed routing slot from incidentRoutingSlotRelationshipTypes: intended_routing -> HAS_INTENDED_ROUTING, applied_routing -> HAS_APPLIED_ROUTING, live_routing -> HAS_LIVE_ROUTING. Both endpoints are :IncidentRoutingEvidence matched by uid, so the source below is the incident uid = facts.StableID(IncidentRoutingEvidence, {node_kind: incident, scope_id: pagerduty:eshu-fixture-incident-routing, provider: pagerduty, provider_incident_id: PINCIDENT6228}) and each target is the routing row uid = facts.StableID(IncidentRoutingEvidence, {node_kind: routing, incident_uid, slot, source_class, evidence_kind, evidence_id}) with evidence kinds content_entity.PagerDutyDeclaration / incident_routing.applied_pagerduty_resource / incident_routing.observed_pagerduty_service and evidence ids declared-entity-6228 / the replay fact_id DeriveFactID(scope, generation, stable_fact_key) for the applied envelope / the same derivation for the observed envelope. The applied and observed evidence ids are the drive-stamped fact_ids, NOT the fixture's literal fact names: the reducer keys evidence identity off the envelope fact_id and the drive derives it per envelope, so this set pins what the live drive converges on. Each re-derived target below was verified by an independent StableID recomputation from the hand-listed inputs. The relationship MERGEs on its two endpoints alone, so there is no identity block; slot, source_class, and truth_label are SET after the MERGE and are asserted here as mutable properties instead. Exactly three edges: the Odù's one incident anchor converges declared/applied/observed exact across the shared Checkout API service (declaration literal via the production HCL parser, applied and observed joined on PSERVICE6228 with matching PEP1 escalation references). The Odù's fourth fact is a tombstoned duplicate applied envelope that the builder skips before decoding, so it contributes no edge on purpose, and its fifth fact is the declaration content_entity envelope the live drive projects into content_entities (the builder ignores that kind without quarantining it, so the guard's decode is unchanged). evidence_source, scope_id, and generation_id are stamped by the WRITER from per-run intent arguments (or its compile-time constant), not carried on the extractor rows, so no static set pins them; their stamping is covered by the cypher writer unit test asserting the annotated row contents instead.
